headline: Your tracks fly the marquee — and the bot stopped raiding the leaderboard
lede: Excitebike's attract demo now cycles MOTOCROSS first, then every saved custom design in roster order, badge and all. The same stage found and fixed a worse bug hiding behind the gap: the unattended demo was posting its own scores to the top-score board and freezing on the results screen.

notes.text: Ground truth first: a 75-second tab drive showed the attract replay reaching its finish line at t2561, writing the bot's 14300 into excitebike.board, then freezing the marquee on the over screen until a key was touched — a new bot line every ~43 seconds of arcade idle.

Two laws shipped: VIEWER SEATS (a demo end on attract/splash submits nothing and never leaves the screen) and SEAT ROTATION (MOTOCROSS byte-honest first, then CUSTOM 1..n, each design riding one honest lap planned lazily by the same autopilot that drives WATCH).

Proof: excitecheck 426/426 with a 19-gate ATTRACT DESIGN block and two by-hand mutants dying by name; exciteplay 137/137 with the finish line crossed by real frames while the board stayed empty and the seat rotated onto the design's terrain.
Pick provenance: never-dry rung #1571 — EXCITEBIKE scored the shelf maximum (4) as weakest; this took its oldest unowned README gap, the attract gap flagged in the last shift's STATE.
